subject: BrightGen vendor onboarding roadmap & MAP confirmation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightgen.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGen vendor onboarding roadmap & MAP confirmation

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Per our conversation I’m attaching a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short checklist to keep procurement and vendor onboarding moving while we close commercial terms. Please review the milestones below and confirm owners / target dates. I’ve kept the plan minimal so your procurement team can action quickly.

Draft MAP highlights (action items / owners / dependencies):
- Milestone 1 — Confirm vendor channel: Ariba vs Coupa (owner: BrightGen procurement / Carlos) — Target: 2025-05-20 — Dependency: procurement platform decision (chooses Ariba per call, please confirm)
- Milestone 2 — Complete vendor profile & W-9 upload to Ariba (owner: BrightGen procurement / Elena) — Target: 2025-05-27 — Dependency: BrightGen provides completed W-9 and vendor tax ID
- Milestone 3 — Banking + ACH authorization / vendor banking form (owner: BrightGen finance) — Target: 2025-05-27 — Dependency: vendor onboarding form + DocuSign for ACH
- Milestone 4 — Redwood legal review & redlines (owner: Redwood legal / Ben Carter) — Target: 2025-05-30 — Dependency: initial SOW / redline window (we’ll share our template once vendor info is in)
- Milestone 5 — PO issuance & vendor activation in Ariba (owner: BrightGen procurement) — Target: 2025-06-02 — Dependency: vendor setup complete + PO terms agreed
- Target commercial close / first invoice: 2025-06-05 (owner: joint)

Attachments included: BrightGen_MAP_v1.xlsx (one-tab MAP with responsibilities), W9_instructions.pdf (how to upload into Ariba).

Open questions / asks for your team:
1) Can you confirm that Ariba is the right platform (vs Coupa)?
2) Please send the completed W-9 and vendor tax ID to procurement@brightgen.com and cc me so we can start the vendor record.
3) Any internal blackout dates for legal / finance review in late May?

If that timeline looks reasonable I’ll add Ben from legal to the MAP and tag the deal in HubSpot (DL-4827). Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock milestones.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightGen_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), W9_instructions.pdf (doc stub)
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightgen.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightgen.com, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@brightgen.com>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGen vendor onboarding roadmap & MAP confirmation

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Appreciated today’s call. Quick answers from procurement: we will use Ariba (confirmed). I’ve attached our completed W-9 for the vendor record and will route the vendor onboarding form to finance for ACH details.

Summary from our side:
- Ariba confirmed (procurement@brightgen.com) — Carlos will start the vendor request on Monday (2025-05-19).
- Attached: BrightGen_W9.pdf (completed) — please add to the vendor profile.
- We require the vendor onboarding form for banking + ACH; finance will Docusign the ACH form once Redwood sends the vendor banking template or Docusign link.
- Please include legal for redlines (Ben Carter) and copy procurement on any changes to commercial terms.

We’re aligned on the target dates but will try to move the Ariba creation earlier if we encounter no blockers. Will confirm PO issuance timeline after vendor profile is accepted in Ariba.

Elena Martinez
Director, Procurement | BrightGen Therapeutics
elena.martinez@brightgen.com | +1 (617) 222-0987

---
Attachments: BrightGen_W9.pdf (signed W-9 stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightgen.com>, procurement@brightgen.com
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGen vendor onboarding roadmap & MAP confirmation

Jordan / Elena —

Looping in legal notes and a couple of items to lock into the MAP:
1) Contract template: please expect a short SOW + standard MSP terms. We aim to limit review to specific redlines (data protections, liability cap). Target turnaround: 3 business days once we get the initial SOW (aiming 2025-05-30 for final redlines).
2) Please add a sub-milestone for Vendor Tax ID collection (we need EIN) — BrightGen procurement to confirm EIN in vendor profile.
3) Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 30; if BrightGen requires Net 45 / 60 please flag now as that impacts finance onboarding.
4) If BrightGen needs SOC2 attestation or any additional security docs during onboarding, procurement/legal should indicate now; we can provision a security pack from Redwood (takes ~48 hours to compile).

I’ve created a HubSpot task under DL-4827 and attached a DocuSign link for the ACH template we typically use. Jordan — will you please push the DocuSign link to them once they confirm banking contact?

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the W-9 & EIN.

Ben Carter
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightgen.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightgen.com, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@brightgen.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGen vendor onboarding roadmap & MAP confirmation

Jordan / Ben —

Thanks — quick alignment from procurement & finance after internal sync. Updated milestone commitments below (we’ll use these as our working MAP inside Ariba):
- 2025-05-19: Procurement opens vendor record in Ariba (Carlos)
- 2025-05-20: Procurement confirms Ariba request & attaches W-9 (Elena)
- 2025-05-22: Finance sends ACH contact info + initiates DocuSign for vendor banking form (Finance)
- 2025-05-27: Vendor setup complete in Ariba (Procurement) + vendor profile active
- 2025-05-30: Redwood legal review / redlines completed (Ben)
- 2025-06-02: PO issued by BrightGen (Procurement)
- 2025-06-05: Target first invoice / commercial go-live

We’ll attach the vendor onboarding form to the Ariba record. I’ve uploaded the W-9 and the vendor onboarding form (Vendor_ONBOARD_FORM_BrightGen.pdf) to our internal portal and will share if Redwood needs a copy. If everything looks good from your side we’ll proceed to open the Ariba request tomorrow.

Elena
